resources.string: Add your OpenAI API key in Settings to start.
Allow HearCopy to display over other apps. In the settings that open, find HearCopy and allow it.
Allow the microphone. Android needs it to capture the audio other apps play; HearCopy never records the microphone.
The microphone is not allowed and Android no longer asks. Tap to open HearCopy\'s app settings, then allow it under Permissions.
Allow audio capture to show the floating button.
Tap the floating button while audio is playing.
Capturing audio, %1$s. Tap the floating button to stop.
The previous transcript stays until the new one is ready.
No audio arrived in time. Tap the floating button to try again.
Audio capture stopped unexpectedly. Tap the floating button to try again.
No sound was captured: nothing was playing, or the app does not allow audio capture. Play it again and retry; if it stays silent, HearCopy cannot capture that app.
No speech was recognised. Capture a part with clear speech and try again.
OpenAI did not accept the API key: it may be wrong, expired or revoked. Replace it in Settings.
The API key is not allowed to transcribe. Check the key\'s project and permissions in OpenAI, or replace it in Settings.
Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
Your OpenAI credit is used up or a spending limit was reached. Add credit or raise the limit in OpenAI, then try again.
The transcription took too long and was stopped. Try again, or capture a shorter clip.
The transcription service could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
The transcription service had a problem. Try again later.
The transcription service refused the clip. Try again; if it keeps happening, run Test transcription in Settings.
The transcription service sent an unexpected answer. Try again.
The clip is too large to upload. Capture a shorter clip.
The API key could not be read this time. Try again; if it keeps failing, enter the key again in Settings.
No transcript yet. Capture some audio and its text appears here.
The last transcript stays until a new one replaces it.
Enter a key made of letters, digits and symbols, with no spaces.
The key could not be saved. Try again.
The key could not be deleted. Try again.
The floating button goes away until you add a key again. The transcript is kept.
Your key is encrypted and stored only on this device. It is sent only to OpenAI.
The saved key could no longer be read and was removed. Enter it again.
Tap the floating button to capture audio.
The floating button is gone. Tap to open HearCopy and start again.
The saved API key can no longer be read. Tap to open HearCopy and enter it again in Settings.
Audio received. Tap to return to HearCopy for the result.
Tap to open HearCopy and copy the text.
Transcript ready. Tap to capture audio again.
Capture failed. Tap to try again.
